Episode 55: Prema's Personal Robot
Prema visits an electronics store as the miniature robot, a gift given to Keshav's son, is malfunctioning. Keshav, who visited the shop earlier, has disguised himself as a robot. Prema is impressed by the robot and finds it quite useful. Later, Keshav finds himself in Prema's house. Will Dilruba find out who is the robot? Watch and find out.
